preconditions.description: The number of crimes Zeyad would like to commit is between 0 and 10^18, inclusive.
The number of conditions Zeyad is aware of is between 0 and 1000, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: Each crime type is a capital Latin letter.
preconditions.description: Each crime type in the input is a single capital Latin letter.

preconditions.expression: Each multiplicity is a positive integer.
preconditions.description: Each multiplicity in the input is a positive integer.

preconditions.expression: The product of all multiplicities does not exceed 123.
preconditions.description: The product of all multiplicities of the crimes does not exceed 123.

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: The output is the number of different ways Zeyad can commit exactly n crimes with no punishment modulo 12345.
postconditions.description: The output represents the number of ways Zeyad can commit n crimes without being punished, considering the given conditions.
